name: Rose Costumes
note: Denton's 50-year-old costume house on the Square rents 10,000+ full costumes to the public ($125-$225/week, accessories and cleaning included) and sells a smaller rack; same-day pickup OK.

name: Spirit Halloween (Golden Triangle)
note: 2026 seasonal pop-up in the former Macy's at Golden Triangle Mall, with packaged costumes, masks, makeup and decor.

name: Spirit Halloween (W University Dr)
note: Second 2026 Spirit pop-up in a former AutoZone, close to downtown and TWU.

name: Goodwill Store & Donation Center (Loop 288)
note: Denton's big Goodwill, a large thrift floor for cheap DIY costume parts, open until 9pm Monday through Saturday.

name: Les Muses Vintage
hours: Tue-Thu 10am-6pm, Fri-Sat 10am-8pm, Sun noon-5pm; closed Mon
note: Square boutique with real 1940s-80s dresses and outfits, good for a pin-up, mod, disco or Old Hollywood costume.

name: Old Bear Denton (University Dr)
note: The cheaper Old Bear location, where everything costs $14.99 or less, which makes it good for building a costume on a budget.

name: Old Bear on the Square
note: Vintage shop on the Square that stays open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays, good for last-minute retro pieces.

name: The Velvet Echo
hours: Wed-Thu noon-8pm, Fri noon-9pm, Sat noon-8pm (check Sun)
note: Downtown boutique that opened in March 2026, carrying vintage clothing, furs and jewelry for glam period looks.

name: Denton Thrift
note: Locally voted Best Thrift Store in Denton, worth a stop for odd costume pieces.

name: Goodwill (W University Dr)
note: Second Goodwill thrift store on the west side; call ahead for hours.

name: Sally Beauty (S Loop 288)
note: South Denton Sally Beauty with colored hair spray, wigs and makeup, open until 9pm midweek.

name: Sally Beauty (W University Dr)
address: 2520 W University Dr Ste 1160, Denton, TX 76201
note: Temporary hair color, wigs and makeup basics for finishing a costume, and Rose Costumes no longer sells wigs or makeup.
